name: Memory of bond
source:
One week left to live.
My world suddenly changed when a curse was cast upon me.

Why is someone after the life of a person like me, who was living a very ordinary life...?
Not knowing the reason why, I searched for a way to break the spell, and stepped into the forest on the outskirts of the country.

Which misfortune is the lesser? 
What will that choice save, and what will it destroy?

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/3728]Freem![/url]]
translation:
还剩下一周的生命。
当诅咒降临到我身上时，我的世界突然改变了。

为什么有人要追寻像我这样过着平凡生活的人的生活……？
不知道为什么，我寻找着打破咒语的方法，踏入了郊外的森林。

哪种不幸较小？
这个选择会拯救什么，又会毁灭什么？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/3728]自由！[/url]]
